BERT4Rec inference appends a reserved mask token and scores items from its contextual representation. RecBole’s implementation uses the same embedding-plus-bias scoring head for individual candidates and the full catalog, excluding the mask token from output candidates. For this task’s left-padded histories, read the final nonpadding mask position; do not copy length-minus-one indexing from implementations with different padding conventions. Recommended parity checks: identical sequence truncation, mask placement, attention masks, output transformations and candidate scores between training-side inference and the generated predictor. [BERT4Rec implementation](https://github.com/RUCAIBox/RecBole/blob/master/recbole/model/sequential_recommender/bert4rec.py)

Full-catalog recommendation requires explicit eligibility filtering and ID conversion. RecBole documents internal-to-external mapping through `id2token`; its recommendation utility excludes padding and conditionally excludes history, with a separate sequential-model path. Therefore, explicitly filter all publicly observed seen items for the required unseen-item recommendations. Suggested checks: encode history once, score catalog chunks with the same head, merge global top-k with deterministic tie handling, and compare against unchunked scores/rankings within numerical tolerance. Use raw logits rather than independently normalized chunk probabilities. [ID mapping](https://recbole.io/docs/recbole/recbole.data.dataset.dataset.html), [recommendation utility](https://github.com/RUCAIBox/RecBole/blob/master/recbole/utils/case_study.py)

Task-specific audit recommendations: each category routes to exactly one trained checkpoint and its saved architecture configuration and ID mappings; external IDs round-trip correctly; overlapping category-local IDs never cross routes. Compare reloaded predictor scores and final external-ID recommendations against the training-side model, including short histories, maximum-length truncation, chunk boundaries and nearly exhausted unseen catalogs. These are proposed checks, not measured results; preserve the pinned sampled-candidate evaluator separately.
